title: [v5.8] Update CI image and some machine test speed backports
body:
Update the VM CI image so we do not have to install slirp4netns anymore.

Also backport some of the machine speedup fixes from #29729 to try to make machine faster and less flaky on this branch since we still have to support it for a while.
